Clause 4.2.subject: Base Interest Rate
Clause 4.2.summary: 9.50% per annum on a reducing balance basis
Clause 4.2.quote:
Clause 4.2: Base Interest Rate
The standard annual interest rate applicable on all approved Retail Personal Loans shall be 9.50% per annum on a reducing balance basis.

Clause 4.2.subject: Base Interest Rate
Clause 4.2.summary: from 9.50% per annum to 10.50% per annum on a reducing balance basis
Clause 4.2.quote: Clause 4.2 of POL-2023-01 is hereby superseded. Effective April 1, 2024, the standard annual interest rate applicable on all Retail Personal Loans is revised from 9.50% per annum to 10.50% per annum on a reducing balance basis.

Clause 4.2.subject: Base Interest Rate
Clause 4.2.quote: Clause 4.2 as amended by CIRC-2024-07 is hereby superseded. Effective April 1, 2025, the currently applicable standard annual interest rate on Retail Personal Loans shall be 11.25% per annum on a reducing balance basis.

Clause 5.1.subject: Late Payment Penalty
Clause 5.1.summary: 2.0% per month shall be levied on the overdue EMI amount (previously unspecified)
Clause 5.1.quote:
Clause 5.1: Late Payment Penalty
If an EMI remains unpaid beyond the 5-day grace period from the due date, a late payment penalty of 2.0% per month shall be levied on the overdue EMI amount.

Clause 5.1.subject: Late Payment Penalty
Clause 5.1.summary: from 2.0% per month to 3.0% per month on the overdue EMI amount
Clause 5.1.quote: Clause 5.1 of POL-2023-01 is hereby superseded. Effective April 1, 2024, the late payment penalty for overdue EMIs beyond the 5-day grace period is increased from 2.0% per month to 3.0% per month on the overdue EMI amount.
